evidence.exception: Single combined owner-ruling ref; consumer changes are dependencies, not extra implementations. Actual outreach, SQLite stores/closure, scheduled runner and extracted actual resolver lock execute with isolated transport/people/time fixtures. Restart discards loaded code/lock while retaining SQLite state; one regression abandons an actual transport promise. No live side effects. The optional original reference must be selected from known history by the existing model; natural-language reference selection and checker obedience are not proven. No new tool, model call, persisted shape, deployment or independent verification claimed. Room tool exposure remains blocked by the existing registry; direct owner-room context is only a scope control. Bouncer bounce1 proved immediate-channel result omitted request_id although the logger had it. That actual return is repaired and actual producer/history/followup regression now executes; attempt1 is preserved and superseded. Final joint integration has8 paths including immediate channel.
